status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment:
The problem was caused by race in TcpCommunicationSpi - connection may have been closed concurrently right after creation.

Issue was fixed by adding post-check to TCP client creation logic. Rev hash - 285d790

Fix has been tested on TC, reviewed by Yakov and merged.
